header: Specifying multiple OpenSearch Service domain sinks
content:
You can specify multiple public OpenSearch Service domains as destinations for your data. You
can use this capability to perform conditional routing or replicate incoming data into multiple
OpenSearch Service domains. You can specify up to 10 diﬀerent public OpenSearch Service
domains as sinks.
In the following example, incoming data is conditionally routed to diﬀerent OpenSearch Service
domains:
...
route:
- 2xx_status: "/response >= 200 and /response < 300"
- 5xx_status: "/response >= 500 and /response < 600"
sink:
- opensearch:
hosts: [ "https://search-response-2xx.region.es.amazonaws.com" ]
aws:
region: "us-east-1"
index: "response-2xx"
routes:
- 2xx_status
- opensearch:
hosts: [ "https://search-response-5xx.region.es.amazonaws.com" ]
aws:
region: "us-east-1"
index: "response-5xx"
routes:
- 5xx_status
